'''Michael Pistone''' (also listed as '''Mike Pistone''' and '''Pistone''') finished 2nd in the Open event at the [[2023 Beezer Bowl]] and played the [[2022 Regional Championships]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-06-2022-regional-championship-events/ 2022 Regional Championships], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021002231/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2022-06-2022-regional-championship-events.html Internet Archive]</ref> His handles are '''Pistone84''' on the Players Committee forum<ref name="tr">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1419629#p1419629 La Polka Live - How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Beezers], Players Committee forum (Pistone84, 21 January 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012191715/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t84078.html Internet Archive], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022024826/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1419629.html Internet Archive]</ref>, '''MadSkills84''' on DeckTech<ref name="dt-18733">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18733 Madskills' Council Chamber Mains], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 1 September 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18733/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18733/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261017024433/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18733/ Wayback Machine].</ref> and '''MPistone''' on [[Game Players Network]].<ref name="gpn-186">[https://web.archive.org/web/20051102154456/http://gameplayersnetwork.com/card/decks.asp?gm=starwars&id=186 System Overload (Admiral Ozzel Superstar) (ISB)], Game Players Network (MPistone, 9 December 2001), Wayback Machine copy.</ref> Pistone posted two lists on DeckTech in 2001 and one on Game Players Network in December 2001.
